insight.caption: A flag composed of three horizontal bands. The top and bottom bands are white, and the middle band is red. A large, solid red circle is centered on the red band. The background is black.
The image depicts a white rectangular flag with a blue square in the bottom-left corner. The flag is set against a black background.
The image displays a green triangle centered on a white background, with a black border. The triangle is sharply defined and occupies the central portion of the image.

A navy blue flag displays a single, bright yellow five-pointed star in the center. The star is positioned approximately in the upper half of the flag. The flag is a rectangular shape and appears to be a standard design.
The image depicts a cluster of overlapping, soft, red circles against a light beige background. A black border surrounds the central area.

The image features a large, clustered group of blue circles, predominantly shades of blue ranging from light to dark. The circles are arranged in a roughly amorphous shape, resembling a cloud or smoke. The background is a solid white color. A black border frames the image.

Two abstract shapes are visible in the image. One is primarily green, transitioning to lighter shades, and the other is predominantly yellow, with a similar gradient. They are arranged side-by-side on a light beige background. A black border surrounds the entire image.
A large, blurred purple shape dominates the image, positioned centrally against a plain white background. A black border frames the image.

The image displays a 3x3 grid of colored squares and triangles arranged in a rectangular frame. The upper left square is red with a white circle. The upper middle square is blue. The upper right square is yellow. The lower left square is green. The lower middle square is orange with a white triangle. The lower right square is purple. The background is a light beige color.

This image depicts a collection of geometric shapes arranged on a textured beige background. Several orange and blue rectangular blocks are visible, with some overlapping. A small, square blue shape is present in the lower right corner. A light beige rectangle occupies the lower left portion of the image. There's a darker, near-black border surrounding the entire composition.

A beige background features a red rectangle, a blue circle, a green triangle, and a yellow star. The shapes are arranged in a slightly staggered fashion, creating a layered composition. A dark black border surrounds the image.

The image depicts a rectangular flag with a central purple circle. The flag is divided into horizontal stripes of varying colors: red, blue, yellow, green, and orange. White stripes run vertically through the flag, creating a grid-like pattern. The background is a neutral beige color.

A large, red sphere is centered on a white background. A black horizontal bar forms the top edge of the image. The sphere has a glossy appearance with subtle shading suggesting three-dimensionality. The background is a light gray.

A large, blue sphere is centered in the image. It has a gradient of color, darker at the top and lighter at the bottom. A dark gray shadow is cast beneath the sphere on a light gray background. A black border frames the entire image.
A solid, three-dimensional green cube is centered against a light gray background. The cube has flat faces and appears to be a geometric shape.
A spherical object, predominantly orange in color, is centered within the image. The sphere has a smooth, reflective surface. The background is a dark gray, providing a simple contrast.

The image depicts a dark window frame with a white webpage displayed within it. The webpage contains a green, orange, and green colored lightbulb icon on the left. Below the icons is a horizontal, gray menu bar with seven light gray lines. A white rectangular login form dominates the center, featuring two horizontal, light gray text input fields and a blue ‘LOGIN’ button. The background of the webpage is white, and the window frame is dark gray.

The image depicts a dark gray computer screen displaying a menu. The menu is segmented into rows of gray horizontal lines. Three small green dots are visible on the top left corner of the screen. The background is a solid dark gray. There is a large, white 'MENU' text element at the center of the screen.

A grey window with a white save dialog box is displayed. The dialog box has a blue 'OK' button and the text 'SAVE' in white. A green and orange border frames the window. The window is set against a blurred grey background.

The image shows a white grid background with a rectangular blue shape in the center. Three small circular icons are visible in the upper left corner, colored red, green, and yellow. A series of gray lines form a horizontal menu bar on the left side. The overall setting appears to be a digital interface.
The word 'SALE' is displayed in red against a white background, set on a black background. The letters are pixelated.

The image consists of a large, rectangular yellow block with the word 'HELLO' rendered in black, pixelated font. The block is set against a black background. The text is centered within the yellow block.
A rectangular green field displays the word 'OPEN' in white, pixelated block letters. The background is black.

A red octagon shape with the word "STOP" in white capital letters is centered on a pale blue background. The shape is geometrically precise with sharp edges. The background is a uniform, light blue color.
A large, solid red circle occupies the entire frame. The background is black.
A bright blue five-pointed star is centered against a black background. The star has a slightly elongated, triangular shape. There are no secondary subjects or background features visible.

A large, solid green triangle dominates the image. The triangle's base is a dark green and its apex is a lighter shade of green. Below the triangle is a solid dark green horizontal line. The background is black.
A full purple circle occupies the image. The circle has a smooth, rounded shape and a solid purple color. The background is black.
The image shows a white background with a red circle on the left and a blue square on the right. The shapes are arranged side-by-side. The background is entirely white.
The image shows three yellow stars arranged in a horizontal line on a white background with black borders. The stars are consistent in shape and size.

The image features three distinct shapes arranged horizontally on a white background. A green triangle is on the left, a red circle is in the center, and a blue square is on the right. The shapes are isolated against a black background. The background is a solid white.

The image features a white rectangular background with a repeating pattern of blue circles. The circles are arranged in rows and columns, creating a grid-like structure. The color of the circles is bright blue. The background is white and appears flat. A black border surrounds the entire image.

A horizontal image depicts a dark blue sky transitioning to orange and yellow hues near the horizon. A bright yellow sun is positioned on the right side of the horizon. A thin, horizontal orange band separates the darker sky from the brighter horizon. The background is a solid black.

The image features a vertical arrangement of parallel stripes. The stripes are green and white, with the green stripes appearing above the white stripes. The stripes are evenly spaced and create a repeating pattern. The background is black.
A white rectangular background with a large red circle centrally positioned. A black border surrounds the entire image. The scene is a flag.

A dark blue background with a single, bright yellow star positioned in the upper right corner of the image. The background is a deep, saturated blue color. The star is a standard five-pointed shape, shining brightly.
A rectangular white background with a large, solid red circle in the center. The circle is on a flag-like design. The background is black at the top and bottom edges.

The image features a large, solid pink square set against a white background. The white area occupies the top and left portions of the image, while the pink square occupies the central area. The background is black. The arrangement creates a simple, two-color composition.
The image consists of a dense, uniform texture of gray pixels. It presents as a solid, grainy surface with no discernible shapes or objects. The background is black.
The image depicts a white background with a single, large, light gray circle centered within it. The circle dominates the composition. The background is solid white.
